Like I just don't know if this being a function is really that much cleaner but :shrug:

If this instance becomes a normal function, then requestRoutesThermal gets all of its BMCWEB_ROUTE instances stacked together in a very reasonable to review function like sessions is:

https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/11183b199c87755ae8615e9189692e650f6d230e/redfish-core/lib/redfish_sessions.hpp#L371

And the broken out function can theoretically be unit tested.  That would make this file so much easier to review when we add routes.



Yes, it's short, yes, it's probably not the first thing I'd break out into a method, but if/when we do, I think it gets simpler.
